name: phonetic key
mechanism: map a word to a short canonical code by keeping its first letter and replacing the rest with classes of similar-sounding consonants while dropping vowels and repeats, so words that sound alike collide on the same code

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Soundex' in section Combinatorial algorithms / Sequence algorithms / Approximate sequence matching: a phonetic algorithm for indexing names by sound, as pronounced in English
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Daitch–Mokotoff Soundex': a Soundex refinement which allows matching of Slavic and Germanic surnames
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Double Metaphone': an improvement on Metaphone
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Match rating approach': a phonetic algorithm developed by Western Airlines
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Metaphone': an algorithm for indexing words by their sound, when pronounced in English
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'NYSIIS': phonetic algorithm, improves on Soundex

requires: a table from letters to sound classes (policy, language-specific)
fails_when: collisions are the point and also the failure: unrelated words share a code
